scripts.label: Export Notes
scripts.description: Concatenates `PROJECT.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `.agent/config.json`, and every progress note into a single markdown file under `<project>/exports/`. Import that file into a [NotebookLM notebook](https://notebooklm.google.com/) as a notes-only source.

scripts.label: Export Codebase
scripts.description: Concatenates source files from the workspace `projects/` tree into one or more `.txt` chunks under ~380KB each (NotebookLM's per-source limit). Excludes `node_modules`, `.git`, build outputs, tests, lockfiles, minified files. Output filename is the project name. **Note:** linked repositories outside `projects/` are not walked — run `scripts/export-codebase.sh` against the repo directly for those.
